title: Simon 6.3.2(3): on open sets the mass of an integer multiplicity current equals its weight measure
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n) and R = (M, θ, ξ) an integer multiplicity representation of T in U (IMRep U n with R.Represents T, i.e. T(ω) = ∫_M θ⟨ω, ξ⟩ dHⁿ for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U), where Hⁿ = μHE[n]). Then for every open W ⊆ U, M_W(T) = μ_R(W), where M_W(T) = T.massOn W is Simon's mass 6.2.5 with the Euclidean coefficient norm (the supremum of T(ω) over ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ W and |ω(y)| ≤ 1 for all y) and μ_R = θHⁿ⌞M = R.measure; both sides are taken in [0, ∞].
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U W : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → R.Represents T → T.massOn W = R.measure W
